trigger: The original-report guard stopped before the new paired-bootstrap readout because default pandas CSV parsing changed dev model position_spearman from 0.43426649802991235 to 0.43426630722766785 through near-tie rounding.
root_cause: The frozen CSV stores .17g values. Default pandas parsing does not guarantee exact round-trip recovery of every adjacent float; Spearman ranks are sensitive to the resulting near-tie changes.
implementation_changes: Use float_precision=round_trip in both production and independent CSV readers.
Run original model/ridge metric reproduction guards before any new paired-bootstrap computation.
Retain the original 1e-12 absolute reproduction tolerance and add a high-precision schema regression assertion.
